whatIsIt.eli5: Makes the picture smaller in two ways at once and keeps both results.
whatIsIt.simple: YOLOv9's downsampling block: a light blur, then the channels are split in half; one half uses a 3×3 stride-2 Conv, the other uses max-pooling plus a 1×1 Conv. The halves are joined.
whatIsIt.engineer: avg_pool2d(2, 1) → chunk(2) → [Conv3×3 s2 (c1/2 → c2/2), MaxPool3×3 s2 → Conv1×1 (c1/2 → c2/2)] → cat.

whyExists.eli5: Two different ways of shrinking keep different kinds of detail.
whyExists.simple: Combining a learned downsample with max-pooling keeps both smooth and sharp information, at lower cost than one full 3×3 Conv.
whyExists.engineer: Mixed learnable / max-pool downsampling with half-width branches.

eli5: Shrink one pile by learning, the other by keeping the strongest.
engineer: Both branches end at ⌈(H−1)/2⌉ via padding 1.
